"""Retain a bounded real-asset vocabulary diagnostic after MLX work finishes."""
import hashlib,json,os,signal,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('Scripts').resolve()))
from model_files import inventory
for pid in (59527,66006):
    while True:
        try: os.kill(pid,0)
        except ProcessLookupError: break
        time.sleep(5)
root=Path.cwd()
pack=root/'Models/Artifacts/composition-adapter-development-pack'
audio=root/'.build/audio-smoke'
output=root/'.build/vocabulary-asset-probe.json'
assert not output.exists()
probe=Path('.context/VocabularyAssetSmokeTests.swift')
binary=Path('Packages/Recognition/.build/out/Products/Debug/RecognitionTests.xctest/Contents/MacOS/RecognitionTests')
assert binary.is_file()
files=[probe,binary,Path('Packages/Recognition/Package.resolved'),Path('Packages/Recognition/Package.swift'),Path('Scripts/model_files.py')]
files+=list(Path('Packages/Recognition/Sources').rglob('*.swift'))
files+=list(Path('Packages/DictationCore/Sources').rglob('*.swift'))
files += [audio/(name+'.wav') for name in ('spoken-006','spoken-010')]
def hashes():return {str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
identity=dict(files=hashes(),models={name:inventory(pack/name) for name in ['recognition','vad']})
command=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-p','(version 1) (allow default) (deny network*)','xcrun','xctest','-XCTest','RecognitionTests.VocabularyAssetSmokeTests/testPinnedVocabularyChangesAndRemoval',str(binary.parents[2])]
env={**os.environ,'POPTART_VOCAB_SMOKE_PACK':str(pack),'POPTART_VOCAB_SMOKE_AUDIO':str(audio),'POPTART_VOCAB_SMOKE_OUTPUT':str(output)}
log=Path('.build/vocabulary-asset-probe-run.log')
with log.open('w') as stream:
    process=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
    try: status=process.wait(timeout=600)
    except BaseException:
        os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.wait();raise
assert identity['files']==hashes()
assert identity['models']=={name:inventory(pack/name) for name in ['recognition','vad']}
rows=json.loads(output.read_text()) if output.exists() else []
passed=status==0 and len(rows)==6 and 'Executed 1 test' in log.read_text()
record=dict(status='Diagnostic only; not general recognition quality or M1 timing evidence.',
    passed=passed,exitCode=status,identity=identity,results=rows,command=command,
    limitations=['Synthetic audio only.','VAD may fall back; its activity is not established by this probe.',
                 'Input pacing adds processing time; no latency claim.','Network-denied subprocess; no separate IP control probe.'],
    probeSource=probe.read_text(),runnerSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),log=log.read_text())
Path('Models/evidence/vocabulary-assets-2026-09-16.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=passed,exitCode=status,results=rows)),flush=True)
if not passed:sys.exit(1)
